name: Bell
source: Bell is mechanical doll about 70 centimeters tall and one of the "Magical Skilled Shells" (Madou Koukaku). She seems rational but seeks contact with marshal of North Capital Kisara - Garmus, while embracing the unconditional affection for him. Out of the four months that exist she represents and takes name of the Red Moon Goddess Belura governing over "Red Moon".
